review.imagery: Root reviewed all 19 brochure index spreads and all 20 scoped website resources. Sixteen original Seef renders cover its frontage, waterfront, courtyard, shared amenities and apartment concepts. Generic portraits, duplicate aerial and similar living-room views excluded. Commented-out Linar resources in the Seef HTML were excluded before candidate extraction. Terrace-pool concepts are scoped to selected designs.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed all 25 complete B3/B4 drawing sheets and every enlarged visible numeric panel. Manual printed totals and exact type labels retained. All unit types, mirrors, garden homes, whole duplexes and penthouses present. Original raster PDF retained without substituted artwork or cropped delivered sheets.
review.location: Root reviewed the original Alef map, its Seef vicinity marker and all seven numeric estimates. Webpage22–25/20–30-minute ranges remain qualified alongside the map25/30 endpoints. No surveyed coordinate, transport mode, traffic result or kilometre figure inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET official project HTML and all 20 original website image resources retain dated URL/byte/SHA256 receipts. Three broker-hosted original Alef PDFs retain honest mirror labels and original bytes. Protected identity and commercial research preserved.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, kilometre journeys, live routes, detailed B1/B2/B5 plans and contracted unit revision remain unverified. Renders and total-area schedules do not establish final finishes or available inventory.
